subject: POC kickoff: FinSight pilot — schedule, roles & hands-on runthrough
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Wu <eleanor.wu@finsight.com>, Samir Patel <spatel@finsight.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff: FinSight pilot — schedule, roles & hands-on runthrough

Hi Eleanor / Samir —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We’re excited to get the FinSight pilot started. To make the kickoff productive, proposed agenda below (60–90m):

- Quick intros (stakeholders & success criteria) — 10m
- Architecture & routing overview (where the calls will hit, model variants) — 15m
- Prompt walkthrough + example prompts and expected outputs — 15m
- Load-day plan and target profiles (burst vs sustained) — 15m
- Hands-on lab: small prompt set + routing test — 20–30m
- Next steps & acceptance criteria

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 6: 10:00–11:30am PT
- Wed Apr 7: 2:00–3:30pm PT
- Thu Apr 8: 11:00–12:30pm PT

I’ve attached a short runbook draft (Runbook_v1.pdf) and a sample load profile (Load_Profile.xlsx). Marcus (CC’d) will own the load tests; Marissa will cover success criteria and rollouts.

If none of these times work, share a couple of windows that suit your team and we’ll adapt. Once we lock a time I’ll send a calendar invite with the lab credentials and a short prep doc.

Thanks —
Camila
Camila Reyes | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: Runbook_v1.pdf (18KB, PDF), Load_Profile.xlsx (22KB, XLSX)

Hi all —

We can absolutely do Thu morning PT. For the hands-on lab I recommend we plan for a small burst (50–100 rps) for the routing test and a sustained run at ~10–20 rps for the acceptance checks. That keeps latency visible while not over-provisioning. I’ll bring the load harness and a reduced prompt set so we can iterate quickly.

I’ll attach a quick harness config after we lock the time.

—Marcus

- Agenda attached in the invite and the runbook (Runbook_v1.pdf) — please skim the prep checklist (slide 2).
- Marcus will lead the load tests. Target profile: burst 75 rps (30s), sustained 15 rps (10m).
